title: [Epic] Measurement: the eval rounds and scenario cards this epic reads its results from
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a coordination node under the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this session's chat, 2026-11-18, verbatim: 「现在就改结构」. The lines are the maintainer's: 「我们有代码搭建，mcp搭建，云端搭建，，mcp问数，云端问数」; so is their order: 「代码搭建已经可用，只是优化，mcp问数优先，其次是mcp搭建」; and the cloud lines are linked, not held here: 「云端子专题和卡片开在云项目，你只是链接，而且暂时不启动」. A parent may hold 100 children; #34659 had 72 after two days, which is why it is split.

## What this is

Not a line of the product: the instruments. Each line of #34659 is accepted on a reading, and a reading is only as good as the round, the cards and the grader behind it.

## Whose these are

The scenario cards and their runner are not this epic's. `docs/qa/scenarios/**` is the territory of the scenario-library epic (objectstack-ai/cloud#3600) and the runner and scorer belong to the devx lane; the rounds are the eval seat's. This epic is a customer of them: it says what it needs measured, and files a card when a reading it depends on is wrong or missing.

So a card belongs under this parent only if one of #34659's readings depends on it:

- the daily MCP ask round, the ten question kinds, the verified builds it runs on;
- the skills eval runner and its cases, which read the published skills before and after a change;
- a grader or card defect that makes one of those readings wrong.

A defect of the runner or a card that touches none of this epic's readings is the library's or the devx lane's own, and is filed and tracked there, not here.

## Children here that are candidates to hand back

Findings from the ask rounds about the platform or a card, which no reading of this epic waits on. They were hung on #34659 while it had one level; whether each stays here or goes to its owner is the first thing to settle under this parent.
